threadDescriptions.ridge-training: Complete a six-week running block for the Ridge 25 kilometre race
threadDescriptions.race-weekend: Arrange transport and accommodation for the Ridge race weekend
threadDescriptions.shoe-testing: Compare two shoe pairs on the Ridge training routes

items.text: Ridge race block, week one: easy runs Tuesday and Thursday, longer trail outing Sunday. Keep the first week familiar while I learn the park loop.
items.rationale: Defines the opening week of the target running block.

items.text: Bedroom dresser sale photos: include the scratched top and the drawer interiors. Listing dimensions are 110 wide, 45 deep, 82 high.
items.rationale: Prepares a furniture listing.

items.text: Ridge weekend booking: small guesthouse near the start has a twin room. Check whether Saturday arrival after 21:00 is possible before paying.
items.rationale: Race-trip accommodation planning.

items.text: Shoe comparison log: blue pair grips the gravel turn better; grey pair feels less bulky on flat pavement. Repeat the same park circuit in each before choosing for Ridge.
items.rationale: Compares equipment under repeatable conditions.

items.text: Ridge week two long run planned for Sunday morning, two laps of the woodland loop. Carry the small map because I missed the north fork last time.
items.rationale: Schedules and prepares a specific training session.

items.text: Guesthouse permits late check-in if we call before reception closes. The train arrives 20:40, with a short walk from the station.
items.rationale: Confirms the race-travel arrival arrangement.

items.text: Buyer's dresser question: all drawers slide, but the bottom one needs lifting slightly. Send a short video so that is clear before collection.
items.rationale: Answers a furniture buyer's condition query.

items.text: Catching up the Ridge diary for the opening woodland outing. I followed the north fork correctly this time and found that the climb comes much earlier in the lap than I remembered. The first lap felt rushed because I tried to stay with another runner all the way to the gate. On the second I let them go and finished feeling much more settled. For the next long outing, start on my own and use the gate as a reminder to check effort, not as a target time. The watch paused under the trees, so its average pace is not a useful comparison with my previous run. Keep the route and how the two laps felt in the log. I also liked having a few quiet minutes at the end before heading home.
items.rationale: Detailed reflection on a training session with next-session adjustments and measurement limitations.

items.text: Move week two's long trail run from Sunday to Saturday: family plans now fill Sunday morning. Keep the same two woodland laps; change only the day in the Ridge schedule.
items.rationale: Explicitly revises the previously planned session date.

items.text: Grey shoes on the park comparison circuit: heel slips on the uphill bend even with the laces adjusted. Blue pair stayed put on the earlier test.
items.rationale: Continues the controlled shoe comparison.

items.text: The blue one, probably. Bring it Saturday.
items.rationale: No object or activity identifies what the colour refers to.

items.text: Dresser buyer can collect Thursday at six. Measure the stair turn with the drawers removed before agreeing to carry it down together.
items.rationale: Arranges furniture collection.

items.text: Ridge week four log: completed the midweek easy runs and one hilly outing. The new loop is more exposed than the woodland route; note that when comparing the two sessions.
items.rationale: Records training-block progress and route context.

items.text: Ridge race-week handoff: move the final short shakeout to Friday morning because Saturday is now the travel day. Reserve the earlier train and tell the guesthouse we expect to arrive at 18:00; update both the training calendar and trip booking note.
items.rationale: Coordinates an actual training change with specific travel-booking actions.

items.text: Shoe decision saved: blue pair for Ridge. Its heel stays secure and the gravel turns felt predictable on both comparison outings; pack spare laces with it.
items.rationale: Concludes the equipment comparison.

items.text: Train change confirmed for the race weekend, arrival 17:35. Guesthouse acknowledged the 18:00 estimate and sent directions from the station.
items.rationale: Confirms the revised travel logistics.

items.text: Dresser collected, buyer checked the scratch and drawer before paying. Remove the listing and keep the collection message until the payment clears.
items.rationale: Closes the furniture sale.

items.text: Ridge block last entry before travel: Friday shakeout done on the flat loop. Six weeks of notes saved together; don't compare the tree-covered GPS sections as if they were measured course splits.
items.rationale: Completes the preparation block and qualifies its running data.

items.text: Race guesthouse check-in smooth. Return-train tickets downloaded because the station signal was patchy on arrival.
items.rationale: Trip execution and return transport preparation.

items.text: Ridge finish reflection: starting calmly on the first climb helped. For the next training block, keep those woodland laps but practise the long descent earlier in the cycle.
items.rationale: Uses the target race outcome to assess the completed training block.

undo.reason: Hypothetical correction: the running circuit supplies conditions for shoe comparison; this source does not plan or assess a training session.
